security.reason: JWT auth and role checks; SQL built by string interpolation in api/users.js:8; execSync with request-supplied table name in api/admin.js:14; Stripe webhook parses body with no signature verification; hardcoded fallback Stripe-style key and JWT secret in src/config.js; CI echoes a secret env var.

external.reason: Stripe SDK client (webhooks.js), outbound fetch to mailprovider in bullmq email worker, Redis-backed queue, webhook receiver.

data.reason: PostgreSQL via pg Pool with raw SQL in all routes; schema is a raw .sql file (no Prisma despite the directory name, no migrations folder); no ORM.

backend.reason: Express app with routers, global error handler that returns stack traces (src/server.js:18), JSON body parsing, background worker and polling script.

frontend.reason: No browser-rendered UI code; JSON API only.

infrastructure.reason: Single CI workflow runs npm ci and npm test on push; no Dockerfile, no lockfile tracked, no deploy step beyond an echo; no .gitignore tracked.

performance.reason: N+1 query pattern in orders list (api/orders.js:8-10), unbounded users list (api/users.js:15), pg Pool default config, polling interval, per-request Stripe client.

quality.reason: Only one test, which asserts a literal against itself and does not exercise the app; no linter or type checker; error handler leaks stack traces.
